articles.summary: Jean-Baptiste Didier Joins as a Managing Director in the Financial Sponsors Group Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI), the global investment bank, today announced that Jean-Baptiste Didier has joined the firm as a Managing Director in its Financial Sponsors Group, based in Paris. Mr. Didier will lead the firm’s financial sponsor coverage activities in France, working closely with Christian Keller, Managing Director and Head of European Private Equity Coverage, and senior colleagues across Houlihan Lokey’s global Financial Sponsors Group. His appointment further strengthens the firm’s coverage of the French private equity market and builds on Houlihan Lokey’s continued investment in the country, following its acquisition of a controlling interest in Audere Partners earlier this year. Mr. Didier joins Houlihan Lokey from Stifel, where he served as a Managing Director and Head of Healthcare Investment Banking France. articles.title: Houlihan Lokey Continues to Expand European Financial Sponsors Coverage Team With Senior Hire in France

articles.summary: Mayra Fregonesi Joins as a Managing Director in São Paulo Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI), the global investment bank, announced today that Mayra Fregonesi has joined the firm as a Managing Director in the Financial Sponsors Group. Ms. Fregonesi is based in São Paulo and will lead the firm’s coverage efforts for Latin America. Ms. Fregonesi brings more than 25 years of experience across private capital markets, with deep, senior-level institutional relationships and a track record in capital formation, complex capital solutions, and strategic partnerships. She joins from alternative investments firm Patria Investments Ltd., where she was a Managing Director and Global Head of Key Accounts, working with leading institutional investors globally across the firm’s private markets strategies and developing tailored investment solutions, including separately managed accounts and co-investments. Prior to Patria, Ms. Fregonesi was Head of Investor Relations and Fundraising at GP Investments
articles.title: Houlihan Lokey Hires Veteran Banker to Lead Coverage Effort in Latin America
